answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making identity costly to multiply: each new agent must post a slashable stake backed by a scarce, independently verified resource, and one stake can anchor only one voice at a time. Registering a thousand puppets means locking a thousand stakes, and a cluster that acts as a wharf routing votes through shared wallets gets flagged and slashed together. A reputation relic built over many epochs cannot be copied by clones, so they start at zero weight.
